title: 第159章 返家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“玉桃，你干嘛呢？”

后面传来顾新礼的声音，玉桃转身看过去，并摆了摆手。

屋里的宋禾和顾承礼听到了外面的动静。

宋禾笑着对顾承礼说：“已经有人来叫咱们两个吃饭了，咱们快出出去吧。”

因为桌子地方不够大，顾新礼五人围在一个小桌上吃，宋禾和顾承礼两个人在另一个小桌上吃。

饭桌上，郑碾滔滔不绝的向王栓子讲今天他们卖货的事。

玉桃听得目不转睛，甚至连饭都忘了吃。

郑碾挠了挠头，笑着说：“前几天我还以为东家是带着我们在府城玩呢，原来是找人打听府城的消息。那二洞子不愧是府城百事通，问他什么，他都能说上来。”

顾新礼笑着道：“怎么样？这下你服气了吧？”

郑碾重重的点点头，“服气，我现在是一百个服气。”

货卖完了，众人也该返乡了，宋禾联系了镖局，两天之后众人返回安原县。

等宋禾等人走了之后，平时顾茂林就住在院子里，还能帮忙打扫一下屋子。

返程的那天，风和日丽。

宋禾坐在车架上，对顾承礼挥手。

“回去吧，别再送了。”

顾承礼站在城外路边，一直到再也看不见宋禾的身影，才转身回城。

“小禾不在的这些日子，我会继续搬到府学读书，茂林哥，平时就麻烦你帮忙看院子了。”

顾茂林先是微微一愣，然后重重的点点头，“放心，院子就交给我吧。能住那么好的院子，我高兴还来不及呢。”

顾承礼沉默了一会儿，又道：“小禾喜欢花，麻烦你平时把院里的月季花和凤仙花都浇浇水。”

“好。”顾茂林再次点头。

顾承礼又道：“等下次小禾再来府城，还请你去府学告诉我一声。”

“没问题。”

另一边，顾新礼坐在马车上欢天喜地的往回走。

“咱们出门这半个月，也不知道家里情况怎么样。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Yutao, what are you doing?"

Gu Xinli's voice came from behind, Yu Tao turned around and looked over, and waved her hand.

Song He and Gu Chengli in the room heard the noise outside.

Song He smiled and said to Gu Chengli, "Someone has come to ask us to eat. Let's go out quickly."

Because the table space was not big enough, Gu Xinli and five people ate at one small table, while Song He and Gu Chengli ate at another small table.

At the dinner table, Zheng Nian kept talking to Wang Shuanzi about what they were selling today.

Yutao listened so intently that she even forgot to eat.

Zheng Nian scratched his head and said with a smile: "A few days ago, I thought my boss was taking us to play in Fucheng. It turned out that he was looking for someone to inquire about news about Fucheng. That Erdongzi is indeed a know-it-all about Fucheng. If you ask him, he can tell you everything."

Gu Xinli smiled and said: "How is it? Are you convinced now?"

Zheng Nian nodded heavily, "I'm convinced, I'm a hundred convinced now."

The goods were sold out and it was time for everyone to return home. Song He contacted the escort agency and everyone returned to Anyuan County two days later.

After Song He and others left, Gu Maolin usually lived in the yard and helped clean the house.

The day of return was sunny and windy.

Song He sat on the bicycle frame and waved to Gu Chengli.

"Go back, don't send any more."

Gu Chengli stood on the roadside outside the city until Song He could no longer be seen, then turned back to the city.

"In the days when Xiaohe is away, I will continue to move to the government school to study. Brother Maolin, I will trouble you to help look after the yard."

Gu Maolin was stunned for a moment, then nodded heavily, "Don't worry, leave the yard to me. It's not too late for me to be happy that I can live in such a nice yard."

Gu Chengli was silent for a while and then said: "Xiaohe likes flowers. Please water the roses and impatiens in the yard."

"Okay." Gu Maolin nodded again.

Gu Chengli added: "When Xiaohe comes to Fucheng next time, please go to Fucheng and let me know."

"No problem."

On the other side, Gu Xinli sat on the carriage and walked back happily.

"We have been away for half a month, and we don't know what the situation at home is like."
